-- La clínica se resuelve igual que en `clinic/patient-portal-config`: una sola
-- instalación, una sola clínica activa. No se depende de un claim del JWT.
SELECT cp.id,
       cp.clinic_id,
       cp.discounts_enabled,
       cp.discount_scope,
       cp.default_discount_pct,
       cp.max_discount_pct,
       cp.identity_document_required
FROM public.clinic_preferences cp
WHERE cp.clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1

-- INSERT … ON CONFLICT: la fila puede no existir si la clínica se creó después
-- de correr el script 068.
INSERT INTO public.clinic_preferences (
    clinic_id, discounts_enabled, discount_scope, default_discount_pct, max_discount_pct, identity_document_required
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
       $1, $2, $3, $4, $5
ON CONFLICT (clinic_id) DO UPDATE
    SET discounts_enabled    = EXCLUDED.discounts_enabled,
        discount_scope       = EXCLUDED.discount_scope,
        default_discount_pct = EXCLUDED.default_discount_pct,
        max_discount_pct     = EXCLUDED.max_discount_pct,
        identity_document_required = EXCLUDED.identity_document_required
RETURNING id,
          discounts_enabled,
          discount_scope,
          default_discount_pct,
          max_discount_pct,
          identity_document_required
